player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task with "DONE" while in the Playroom, failing to explore the "north" direction which likely led to unvisited rooms (specifically the path back to the Craft room and potentially others). My strategy error was assuming the map was fully explored after visiting a dead-end (Balcony) and returning, without verifying if all available directions from the current node had been fully traversed to discover new nodes. Next time, I will maintain a strict list of visited rooms and, upon returning to a room with multiple available directions, I will explicitly check if any direction leads to a room not yet in my "nodes" list. I will only issue "DONE" when I am in a room where all available directions lead to already visited nodes, and I have confirmed no other unvisited nodes exist in my graph. Specifically, in the Playroom, I should have gone "north" to re-enter the Craft room and check if the "west" direction (leading to Nursery) or any other path from Craft room had unvisited branches, rather than stopping immediately.
